title: Reddit Stock Pops 11% on S&P 500 Inclusion Despite Google AI Traffic Concerns
excerpt: Reddit shares rose 11% on S&P 500 inclusion news, even as Google's AI Overviews pressure its search traffic.
content_html:
Reddit shares surged 11% in extended trading Thursday after S&P Dow Jones Indices confirmed the platform will join the S&P 500.

Reddit is only the second pureplay social media stock in the benchmark index after Meta.

Reddit's Index Debut, By the Numbers

S&P Dow Jones Indices said Reddit (RDDT) will replace AvalonBay Communities in the S&P 500 before trading opens on Aug. 18, 2026, once Equity Residential completes its acquisition of AvalonBay.

Reddit shares climbed to $175.38 in postmarket trading following the news, up from Thursday's $153.12 close, a gain of nearly 11%, according to TradingView data.

Index funds that track the S&P 500 must now buy Reddit shares to match the benchmark, a mechanical demand shock that helps explain jumps like this even absent fresh business news.

The same announcement added Sun Communities to the S&P MidCap 400 effective Aug. 20, replacing Webster Financial as Banco Santander's acquisition of Webster nears completion.

Reddit's addition leaves Meta as the only two pureplay social platforms in the S&P 500. Pinterest and Snap both went public earlier but remain too small by market cap for inclusion, and Twitter exited the index once Elon Musk acquired the company and rebranded it X under SpaceX.

A Rally That Follows a Rough Earnings Reaction

Thursday's pop arrives less than three weeks after Reddit's second quarter results split investors. The company posted its eighth straight quarter of revenue growth above 60%, yet shares initially sold off after CEO Steve Huffman flagged uncertainty around Reddit's dependence on Google for new users.

"Search referrals were choppy in the quarter, and traffic was more volatile later in the quarter."

Steve Huffman, in a letter to Reddit investors

Huffman tied the volatility to Google's growing use of Gemini-powered AI Overviews, which answer search queries directly on the results page instead of routing users to sites like Reddit. The concern is not unique to Reddit. AI-generated search summaries are reshaping how publishers and crypto projects compete for visibility online.

S&P 500 membership does not resolve that structural question. It does guarantee Reddit a new base of buyers uninterested in the AI-traffic debate, since index funds must now simply hold the stock.

Reddit joins a short list of once-fringe internet companies using S&P inclusion to cement mainstream investor legitimacy. Coinbase joined the index in 2025, a milestone Strategy has not achieved despite its size.

Whether Reddit's search-traffic risk resurfaces once the passive-buying wave settles is the open question heading into Aug. 18.

Read the Original story Reddit Stock Pops 11% on S&P 500 Inclusion Despite Google AI Traffic Concerns by Darryn Pollock at beincrypto.com

content_html_zh:
在标准普尔道琼斯指数确认该平台将加入标准普尔 500 指数后，Reddit 股价周四在盘后交易中飙升 11%。

Reddit 是基准指数中仅次于 Meta 的第二只纯社交媒体股票。

Reddit 索引首次亮相，从数字看

标准普尔道琼斯指数表示，一旦 Equity Residential 完成对 AvalonBay 的收购，Reddit (RDDT) 将在 2026 年 8 月 18 日开盘前取代标准普尔 500 指数中的 AvalonBay Communities。

根据 TradingView 的数据，消息传出后，Reddit 股价在盘后交易中从周四收盘价 153.12 美元攀升至 175.38 美元，涨幅接近 11%。

追踪标准普尔 500 指数的指数基金现在必须购买 Reddit 股票以匹配基准，这是一种机械需求冲击，有助于解释即使没有新的商业新闻也能出现这样的跳跃。

同一份公告将 Sun Communities 纳入标准普尔中盘 400 指数，并于 8 月 20 日生效，取代 Webster Financial，因为桑坦德银行 (Banco Santander) 对 Webster 的收购即将完成。

Reddit 的加入使 Meta 成为标准普尔 500 指数中仅有的两个纯社交平台。 Pinterest 和 Snap 都较早上市，但市值仍然太小，无法纳入其中；而在埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 收购该公司并将其更名为 SpaceX 旗下的 X 后，Twitter 就退出了该指数。

盈利反应不佳后的反弹

距离周四的流行音乐发布不到三周，Reddit 第二季度业绩让投资者产生了分歧。 该公司连续第八个季度收入增长超过 60%，但在首席执行官史蒂夫·霍夫曼 (Steve Huffman) 表示 Reddit 新用户依赖谷歌存在不确定性后，该公司股价最初遭到抛售。

“本季度的搜索推荐量波动较大，本季度后期的流量波动更大。”

史蒂夫·霍夫曼 (Steve Huffman) 在致 Reddit 投资者的一封信中

霍夫曼将这种波动性与谷歌越来越多地使用由 Gemini 驱动的人工智能概述联系在一起，该概述直接在结果页面上回答搜索查询，而不是将用户引导到 Reddit 等网站。 这种担忧并非 Reddit 独有。 人工智能生成的搜索摘要正在重塑出版商和加密货币项目争夺在线知名度的方式。

标准普尔 500 指数成员资格并不能解决结构性问题。 它确实保证了 Reddit 有了一个对人工智能流量争论不感兴趣的新买家基础，因为指数基金现在必须简单地持有股票。

Reddit 加入了利用标准普尔纳入来巩固主流投资者合法性的曾经边缘互联网公司的名单。 Coinbase 于 2025 年加入该指数，尽管规模庞大，但战略尚未实现这一里程碑。

一旦被动购买浪潮平息，Reddit 的搜索流量风险是否会重新出现，这仍是 8 月 18 日到来之前的一个悬而未决的问题。
